image_location_description: Bottom of the model (under both feet): two blocky white feet on a small shared base.

steps.title: LBG reinforcement pad
steps.description: Place 2x Light Bluish Gray 1x4 plates side-by-side (2x4).

steps.title: Lock the seam
steps.description: Add 1x White 1x2 plate across the middle seam of the LBG pad.

steps.title: White base layer
steps.description: On top, place 2x White 2x4 plates side-by-side (make 4x4).

steps.title: Foot base plates
steps.description: Add 2x White 2x3 plates at the front: left and right foot.

steps.title: Thicken foot bases
steps.description: Stack 2x White 2x3 plates on top of the foot plates.

steps.title: Build left foot block
steps.description: On left foot, place 3x White 1x2 bricks to fill the 2x3 area.

steps.title: Build right foot block
steps.description: On right foot, place 3x White 1x2 bricks to fill the 2x3 area.

steps.title: Main foot tiles
steps.description: Top each foot with 1x White 2x2 tile (2 tiles total).

steps.title: Finish toe tiles
steps.description: Add 1x White 1x2 tile to each foot to complete the 2x3 top.

steps.title: Rear base strip
steps.description: Behind the feet, add 1x White 1x4 plate (back row of base).

steps.title: Rear strip tiles
steps.description: Tile the rear strip with 2x White 1x2 tiles (covers the 1x4).
